article.story: ROCK HILL, S.C. -- — Zach had 24 points in Chattanooga’s 90-79 win over Winthrop on Wednesday. Bleshoy added nine rebounds for the Mocs (3-2). Yonatan Levy added 21 points while shooting 6 for 11 (4 for 8 from 3-point range) and 5 of 7 from the free-throw line while they also had six rebounds. Lenny Anigbata shot 4 for 10 (4 for 7 from 3-point range) and 2 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points, while adding eight rebounds. Spence Sims led the Eagles (0-5) in scoring, finishing with 18 points. Keshawn Fisher added 12 points, eight rebounds and three steals for Winthrop. Anthony Smith III finished with 12 points. Up next Both teams play again on Saturday. Chattanooga hosts Radford and Winthrop travels to play Wofford. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
